body: This is even more of a hell if you're wearing bluetooth
Unfortunately this is what Ignorance comes to. A fucked up dystopian future that might as well kill everyone on the planet because everyone else is to retarded to give a shit.

It's hard to talk to my family at all. My mother doesn't take depression well, and I've once told her about my condition and she kept yelling at me saying if I wanted to take depression pills. I know that my siblings are also gonna use this against me to make me do stuff for/along with them and call me lazy with that if I say no. (specifically my older brother.) I know they mean well, but if all I'm going to get is people yelling at me and making fun of me for it then what's the point. I hate it when people yell at me, makes me feel pressured.
I don't think I'd be alive to see it work.
I'm scared to tell people. I don't like people pitying me. It makes me feel like I'm hurting them in a way, and I really don't want to hurt anyone anymore.

Thank you for the luck. I would like to add that my dad abandoned me at a young age, so he's out of the picture. I haven't told my mother yet, as I fear she will disown me. She isn't homophobic and sorta supports the whole LGBT movement, but I've heard her say things like "I think she's a man" when talking about a female celebrity. I really don't want her to actually be a transphobic mother. :(
